Dental tourism Turkey
Dental treatment in Istanbul — we save your natural teeth first.
A healthy tooth, once lost, never grows back. So we treat and repair your own teeth first — root canal before extraction, filling before crown, composite before veneers — and recommend an implant only when a tooth truly can't be saved.
- ✓ Natural teeth saved first
- ✓ No unnecessary treatment
- ✓ Fixed written quote
- ✓ One dentist — full responsibility
We answer calls on WhatsApp — call or message us there, voice or video.
Save first, replace only when needed
Our ethical protocol: we try to keep your natural teeth. Root canal treatment, fillings and composite come before implants, crowns and veneers — no upselling, no unnecessary procedures.
Root Canal Treatment
Saves an infected or badly inflamed tooth instead of extracting it. Most teeth can be saved — and should be.
Tooth Fillings
Aesthetic composite fillings that restore decayed teeth. Done correctly, they last for many years.
Teeth Cleaning
Professional scaling and polishing that removes tartar and stains — the basis of healthy gums.
Composite Veneers
Smile makeover with tooth-coloured composite, sculpted directly on the teeth — usually without grinding and in a single session.
Teeth Whitening
In-office whitening that lightens natural teeth by several shades in a single visit.
Zirconia Crowns
Strong, metal-free crowns that protect weakened teeth and look natural — the most durable crown option available.
Porcelain Veneers
Thin porcelain shells bonded to the front of the teeth to correct colour, shape and small gaps — with only as much tooth reduction as is truly necess…
Hollywood Smile
A complete smile makeover planned digitally — with veneers or crowns designed to suit your face, not a one-size-fits-all bright white.
Dental Implants
A titanium root and a natural-looking crown that permanently replace a missing tooth. At our clinic an implant is the last resort — we try to save yo…
All-on-4 Implants
A complete fixed set of teeth on four (or six) implants per jaw — for patients who have lost most of their teeth or wear dentures.
Real patients, real results
Videos are published with patients' explicit consent. All patient videos →
Before & after — our own patients
Every photo is a real patient of our clinic, shared with their consent. Drag to compare.
From the first message to your new smile
- 1. Send a photo or X-ray Message us on WhatsApp. The dentist reviews your case personally.
- 2. Get a plan and fixed price You receive an honest treatment plan and a written quote within 24 hours.
- 3. Travel to Istanbul We schedule your appointments around your travel dates.
- 4. Treatment & aftercare After you fly home, WhatsApp follow-up continues — you are never alone.
Search dental clinics in Turkey
Filter by treatment, city and language — and compare verified clinics side by side.
Let us call you
Wherever you are, fill in the form for a short consultation. No commitment, no pressure.
- Reply within 24 hours
- No obligation whatsoever
- Fixed price — no hidden fees
For a faster reply, message the dentist directly:
WhatsApp ekinsipahi8@gmail.com
Free assessment — no obligation
Send us a photo or X-ray. Our dentist will reply with an honest treatment plan and a fixed price.
We answer calls on WhatsApp — call or message us there, voice or video.
